objective: Repair the durable evidence-retention gaps for two official specialty-roaster product details without promoting candidate knowledge.

raw_to_normalized_provenance.retained_raw_material: bounded sanitized field values, extraction paths, response digest and response metadata only

repeatability_criteria.price_and_availability_changes: record as temporal deviations; never infer a transaction price or cross-branch validity

deep_audit_criteria: all bounded attempts complete without a transport/runtime failure
both sources yield attributable sellable roasted-coffee product identity and displayed price
official HTTPS canonical identity remains stable across both observations
every retained non-null normalized field has raw-to-normalized provenance
retail roasted-bean products remain distinct from cafe menu prices
repeat observations retain identity while recording price, availability, variant or attribute deviations
stop_conditions: stop after four acquisition attempts regardless of yield
stop a source immediately on authentication, CAPTCHA, challenge, access-control or anti-bot evidence
stop on redirect outside the configured official host
stop before retaining a response larger than the configured byte limit
stop with technical failure if durable evidence cannot be written
never escalate to browser, Edge Runner, proxy, session reuse or private API
